snippet: claude_lesson_planning_artifact_lands_via_plan_accept LESSON (harness-agnostic):...
text: claude_lesson_planning_artifact_lands_via_plan_accept LESSON (harness-agnostic): assessments, scopes, plans and ADRs are planning artifacts (docs/workbay/rules/planning-artifact-home.md). They reach main through a planning review with verdict pass and zero open planning findings, then the operator runs make plan-accept TASK=<ref> PLAN=<path> SOURCE_BRANCH=<branch>, which lands a docs-only commit of the file. They do not land by branch merge. For such a task, hand make task-finish only after plan-accept has landed the file (extends lesson 18745). Incident, DESCPICK-2 (2026-10-28): the operator ran task-finish right after committing 7ee1ea737c on feature/descpick-2. Result: row archived with status done, worktree removed, branch kept (finish=cleanup_pending, branch=skipped_identity_unrecorded, because no handoff rows exist at the tip). The identity guard is what saved the unmerged branch. Writes to the archived DESCPICK-2 row are then refused (Peer branch-switch or missing worktree) until a worktree on the branch exists again. Nothing was lost, but the assessment exists only on the branch, and the task must be reopened for the planning review.
